reason: Hypothesis B provides a more specific, testable mechanism by explicitly linking the stratified oxide scale evolution (Al2O3 inner layer, Cr/Ti-rich outer layers) to grain-boundary diffusion and predicting distinct failure modes (interfacial spallation vs. internal oxidation) under oxidizing vs. reducing conditions, with a clear falsification rule tied to observable scale structure and integrity. Hypothesis A is more generic, lacks the same level of mechanistic detail on layer interactions, and its predictions are less sharply defined for distinguishing the proposed mechanism.
